arabic_html:
قَدْ أَفْلَحَ مَن زَكَّىٰهَا
وَقَدْ خَابَ مَن دَسَّىٰهَا ۞
translation: He has succeeded who purifies it, and he has failed who corrupts it.
explanation_html: Ibn Kathīr: the one who purifies himself by obedience to Allah succeeds; the one who corrupts his soul fails. Real success isn't around you — it is the state of your soul.
explanation_vo: Ibn Kathir: the one who purifies himself by obedience to Allah succeeds; the one who corrupts his soul fails. Real success isn't around you — it is the state of your soul.
